description: Bright, stylish, and full of charm, this two-level Sausalito home delivers easy coastal living with a smart layout and inviting spaces throughout. The main level welcomes you with soaring ceilings, a classic brick fireplace, and a sunlit living room that opens to a private balcony - perfect for morning coffee, fresh air, and leafy outlooks. The dining area flows comfortably into the kitchen, where cream cabinetry, tile counters, full-size appliances, and a convenient pass-through create a cheerful, functional hub for everyday living. A spacious main-level bedroom, full bath, in-unit laundry, and generous closet storage add comfort and practicality. Upstairs, a loft-style sitting area overlooks the living room below, bringing volume, light, and flexibility to the floor plan. The upper bedroom feels airy and peaceful with vaulted ceilings, ample closet space, a nearby full bath, and access to a second balcony with extra storage. Fresh neutral finishes, soft natural light, multiple outdoor spaces, and a cozy fireplace give this home an easy, welcoming feel from the moment you step inside. With approximately 1,124 square feet of living space, two bedrooms, two baths, in-unit laundry, storage, and a desirable Sausalito location near waterfront paths, shops, restaurants, ferry service, and Marin commuter routes, this is a polished and practical find in one of the Bay Area's most loved coastal communities.
